description.value: Each Afflicted gains an aura: a creature ending its turn adjacent to one takes 2d6 poison damage and must succeed at a Fortitude save or be sickened 1, once per creature per round regardless of how many Afflicted it's adjacent to.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. (the aura must apply to every dynamically-created Afflicted actor, not a fixed recipient) compounded by the same unprecedented schema-corner problem as Sickroom Air (the "once per creature per round" recurring-save shape). The Aura rule element's schema (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/aura.ts:41-80) technically supports a per-effect turn-end event with a save sub-object, which would fit a "creature ending its turn in an aura attempts a save" clause. But an exhaustive search of every shipped item using Aura with save populated (grep -rl "\"key\": \"Aura\"" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/ | xargs grep -l "\"save\"") turns up only files where "save" appears elsewhere in the same actor document (system.saves), never inside the Aura rule element itself -- confirmed by reading chafkhem.json's "Despair" and dread-dhuthorex.json's "Frightful Presence", both of which use only radius/slug/traits or an effects[].uuid grant on "enter", never the save sub-field. The schema field exists but is unused anywhere in the shipped compendium, so this is not authored blind against an unprecedented schema corner.
